item.title: Leander police looking for suspect accused of trying to sell fake jewelry
item.description: Leander police are asking for help identifying the suspect accused of trying to sell fake jewelry.Police said on Jan. 30, the suspect tried to sell fake jewelry at a jewelry store in the 300 block of N. Hwy 183.If you know who the suspect is or have any information, contact Detective Hubbs at 512-528-2805 or khubbs@leandertx.gov and reference case #26-0207.

item.title: Are cars with remote drivers coming to Austin?
item.description: You've seen self-driving cars around Austin, but the city could soon have cars that are remotely driven by a person behind a screen.This wouldn't be a rideshare service. item.title: Texas voters to weigh 10 propositions on the ballot in March 2026 Republican Primary
item.description: As early voting nears for the March 3 Republican primary, Texas GOP voters will not only decide their party’s nominees but also weigh in on 10 non-binding propositions designed to signal the priorities of the GOP ahead of the next legislative session.The Republican Party of Texas released the list of ballot propositions after members of the State Republican Executive Committee approved the measures during a Sept. 6, 2025 meeting on a 59-3 vote, with two abstentions.Voting informationEarly voting
